title: Why tomorrow’s nanotechnologies need support today
excerpt: The field seems to be on the cusp of big advances, but a concerted effort is needed to realize its true potential.
content_html:
• NATURE INDEX
  • 29 July 2026

The field seems to be on the cusp of big advances, but a concerted effort is needed to realize its true potential.

By

  • Bec Crew0
  1. Bec Crew

    1. Senior editor, Nature Index

During the pandemic, the mRNA COVID-19 vaccines developed by Moderna and the Pfizer–BioNTech collaboration reached widespread clinical use in record time, thanks to unprecedented funding, regulatory flexibility and early manufacturing investment. This rapid development was made possible by decades of discoveries in RNA biology and nanoscale delivery technologies through work that often had no obvious practical application.

Nature Index 2026 Nanoscience and nanotechnology

Many of the advances described in this supplement are at similarly early stages. From RNA-based nanostructures to emerging materials for imaging and energy applications, their potential lies in understanding, and ultimately harnessing, behaviours at the nanoscale. RNA, for example, has already proved to be more than a genetic messenger, serving as a foundation for molecular switches, programmable biological circuits and self-assembling nanostructures. Yet gaps remain in scientists’ understanding of how these designs behave and respond to the environment of living cells. A new class of nanomaterials might enable more powerful X-ray imaging, but challenges around long-term stability and durability must be overcome.

Nature 655, S1 (2026)

该领域似乎正处于重大进步的风口浪尖，但需要共同努力才能实现其真正的潜力。

By

  • 贝克·克鲁0
  1. Bec Crew 自然索引高级编辑

在大流行期间，得益于前所未有的资金、监管灵活性和早期制造投资，Moderna 和辉瑞与 BioNTech 合作开发的 mRNA COVID-19 疫苗在创纪录的时间内达到了广泛的临床应用。 这种快速发展是通过几十年来在 RNA 生物学和纳米级递送技术方面的发现而实现的，这些发现通常没有明显的实际应用。

自然索引 2026 纳米科学和纳米技术

本增刊中描述的许多进展同样处于早期阶段。 从基于 RNA 的纳米结构到用于成像和能源应用的新兴材料，它们的潜力在于理解并最终利用纳米尺度的行为。 例如，RNA 已被证明不仅仅是一种遗传信使，它还是分子开关、可编程生物电路和自组装纳米结构的基础。 然而，科学家们对这些设计如何表现以及如何响应活细胞环境的理解仍然存在差距。 一类新型纳米材料可能会实现更强大的 X 射线成像，但必须克服长期稳定性和耐用性方面的挑战。
